name: install_adb_package
description: Install one local APK on the device (`adb install [-r]`), recording the APK's host digest and byte size. A device-mutating tool: `replace` re-installs over an existing package while keeping its data; the device's own Success/Failure verdict is preserved with its reason.

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Existing local APK file to install

__schema2.description: Replace an existing installation and keep its data (adb install -r)

apk_path.description: Existing local APK file to install

replace.description: Replace an existing installation and keep its data (adb install -r)

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it
